paragraphs.zh: 氰化物杂质污染，经过污染物致突变性检测(Ames)能得到正的Ames测试实验结果，但这并不是其固有性质，是残留的氰化物杂质所产生的结果。
paragraphs.en: contaminated with cyanide impurities; after mutagenicity testing of the contaminant (Ames) a positive Ames test result can be obtained, but this is not an intrinsic property of it, it is a result produced by the residual cyanide impurities.
paragraphs.notes: Orphan lines at the very top of the page, above the first bold section heading. No [00NN] marker is printed on this page for them: they are the tail of the paragraph that ends on the previous page. The marker [0011] is not read off this page; it is taken from the text layer of the preceding page (description 1/8), whose last printed marker is [0011] and whose final line breaks off mid-sentence in a way that joins onto the first characters here. The joined sentence reads awkwardly in the original (the noun phrase runs on without a linking word) and has not been smoothed.

paragraphs.zh: 发明内容
paragraphs.en: Summary of the invention
paragraphs.notes: Bold unnumbered section heading, printed between the orphan continuation lines and [0012].

paragraphs.zh: 为了解决现有技术存在的不足，本发明的目的在于提供一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法，解决环磺酮产品的Ames测试实验的问题以及纯化环磺酮产品。
paragraphs.en: In order to resolve the deficiencies of the prior art, the object of the present invention is to provide a purification method for a tembotrione product, resolving the problem of the Ames test on the tembotrione product and purifying the tembotrione product.
paragraphs.notes: The product name throughout this page is the Chinese common name for tembotrione, translated on the authority of the patent itself, which prints the name followed by "(tembotrione)" in parentheses at [0002] on the previous page. The sentence is circular as written: the stated object is both to solve the Ames-test problem and to purify the product. Translated literally.

paragraphs.zh: 为实现上述目的，本发明提供的一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法，包括以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: To achieve the above object, the purification method for a tembotrione product provided by the present invention comprises the following steps:

paragraphs.zh: 1)将环磺酮产品溶解在含水溶液中，升温；
paragraphs.en: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature;
paragraphs.notes: The solvent term used here and in [0016] to [0018] means literally "water-containing solution" rather than "aqueous solution" in the water-only sense; [0017] defines it as an organic solvent mixed with water, so it denotes a solvent/water mixture. The step-number bracket is printed as a half-width ')' and is kept as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 2)加入吸附剂，进行保温、热过滤；
paragraphs.en: 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding at temperature and hot-filtering;

paragraphs.zh: 3)控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下，降温、从溶液中结晶出纯化的环磺酮。
paragraphs.en: 3) adjusting, under temperature control, the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3, cooling, and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，所述步骤1)中所述含水溶液，为乙腈、甲醇、乙醇、二甲基甲酰胺与水混合得到的溶液。
paragraphs.en: Further, the aqueous solution in said step 1) is a solution obtained by mixing acetonitrile, methanol, ethanol or dimethylformamide with water.
paragraphs.notes: The four solvents are separated by ideographic commas and the phrase "mixed with water" applies to the list as a whole; the Chinese does not say whether they are alternatives or whether all four are combined. Translated as alternatives because a four-solvent mixture would be unusual, and the ambiguity is flagged here rather than resolved.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，所述步骤1)中含水溶液中含水量为20％～40％。
paragraphs.en: Further, the water content of the aqueous solution in said step 1) is 20% to 40%.
paragraphs.notes: The full-width percent sign and the full-width tilde used as the range separator are kept as printed in zh.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，步骤1)所述升温，是将温度升至30℃～60℃。
paragraphs.en: Further, the raising of the temperature in step 1) is raising the temperature to 30 to 60 degrees C.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，步骤2)中所述保温的时间在0.2h～1h。
paragraphs.en: Further, the holding time in step 2) is 0.2 h to 1 h.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，在所述步骤2)之后，还包括：有机溶剂萃取蒸馏、入含水溶液的步骤。
paragraphs.en: Further, after said step 2), it also comprises: a step of organic-solvent extraction and distillation, and entering into an aqueous solution.
paragraphs.notes: Chemically ambiguous as printed and translated literally. The final clause lists "organic-solvent extraction and distillation" and then "entering an aqueous solution" with no verb before "entering": a character such as "add" or "transfer" appears to be missing there. The intended operation is probably to extract into organic solvent, distil the solvent off, and take the residue back up into an aqueous solution, but that reading is not stated on the page and has not been supplied. Note also that this paragraph inserts an extraction step between step 2) and step 3) without renumbering the steps.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，所述吸附剂为活性炭或硅藻土。
paragraphs.en: Further, said adsorbent is activated carbon or diatomaceous earth.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，步骤3)所述控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下的步骤，包括，将含水溶液中加入盐酸调节pH至3以下。
paragraphs.en: Further, the step in step 3) of adjusting, under temperature control, the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 comprises adding hydrochloric acid to the aqueous solution to adjust the pH to below 3.
paragraphs.notes: The second clause restates the first almost word for word. [0024] then repeats the same clause a third time; see the note on [0024].

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，进一步包括，将含水溶液中加入盐酸调节pH至3以下。
paragraphs.en: Further, it further comprises adding hydrochloric acid to the aqueous solution to adjust the pH to below 3.
paragraphs.notes: APPARENT DUPLICATION, TRANSCRIBED AS PRINTED AND NOT MERGED. This paragraph carries the same substantive content as the second half of [0023]: both end with the identical clause "add hydrochloric acid to the aqueous solution to adjust the pH to below 3", and they differ only in the framing words before it ([0023] frames it as what the step-3) pH adjustment comprises; this paragraph frames it as "further, it further comprises"). Both markers and both texts are printed on the page and are recorded separately here; no attempt has been made to decide which is the redundant one. The framing itself also duplicates the word "further" twice inside the one sentence, exactly as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步地，所述步骤3)中，搅拌速度在150转至200转。
paragraphs.en: Further, in said step 3), the stirring speed is 150 revolutions to 200 revolutions.
paragraphs.notes: The stirring speed is printed as a number of revolutions with no time unit at all: neither "per minute" nor "/min" appears. Translated literally as revolutions; rpm is the likely intent but is not printed.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明的磺酮产品的纯化方法，可大大降低磺酮产品中氰化物杂质的含量，提高了产品的纯度，通过将纯化前的环磺酮产品与纯化后的产品进行Ames检测，原本氰化物杂质含量由1327ppm降至100ppm以下。
paragraphs.en: The purification method for a sulfonyl-ketone product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the sulfonyl-ketone product and improves the purity of the product; by carrying out Ames testing on the tembotrione product before purification and on the product after purification, the cyanide impurity content, originally 1327 ppm, is reduced to below 100 ppm.
paragraphs.notes: The product name is printed twice in this paragraph WITHOUT its leading character, giving a shortened form that reads as "sulfonyl-ketone product" rather than the tembotrione name used in the title, in [0012] and later in this same sentence. Read as printed and not corrected; the same shortened wording appears in the abstract on the front page. Translated literally so the printed difference stays visible. The sentence also attributes the impurity drop to Ames testing, which detects mutagenicity rather than removing impurities; translated literally.

paragraphs.zh: 具体实施方式
paragraphs.en: Specific embodiments
paragraphs.notes: Bold unnumbered section heading, printed between [0026] and [0027]. Everything from [0027] onwards on this page sits under it.

paragraphs.zh: 以下结合具体实施例对本发明做进一步详细说明。应理解，这些实施例是用于说明本发明的基本原理、主要特征和优点，而本发明不受以下实施案例的限制、实施案例中采用的实施条件可以根据具体要求做进一步的调整，未注明的实施条件通常为常规实验中的条件。
paragraphs.en: The present invention is further described in detail below in conjunction with specific examples. It should be understood that these examples serve to illustrate the basic principles, main features and advantages of the present invention, and that the present invention is not limited by the following worked examples; the implementation conditions used in the worked examples may be further adjusted according to specific requirements, and implementation conditions not stated are usually those of routine experiments.

paragraphs.zh: 合成方案包括以下内容：
paragraphs.en: The synthesis scheme comprises the following:

paragraphs.zh: 向三口烧瓶加入的2‑氯‑3‑(2,2,2‑三氟乙氧基)甲基‑4‑甲磺酰基苯甲酰氯，1,2‑二氯乙烷，保温15℃搅拌。缓慢加入氯化亚砜。常温反应0.5h，升温至75℃，保温3h。中控检测原料含量≤0.2％，在‑0.098mP下减压蒸出溶剂至85℃，脱去溶剂以及过量的氯化亚砜。重新加入新的1,2‑二氯乙烷和三乙胺，投入1,3环己二酮和丙酮氰醇40℃保温6h。检测反应完全。过滤出三乙胺盐，减压浓缩得红棕色固体。
paragraphs.en: Into a three-necked flask were added 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl chloride and 1,2-dichloroethane, held at 15 degrees C and stirred. Thionyl chloride was added slowly. Reacted at room temperature for 0.5 h, warmed to 75 degrees C and held for 3 h. In-process control showed a starting-material content of not more than 0.2%; the solvent was distilled off under a reduced pressure of -0.098 mP up to 85 degrees C, removing the solvent together with the excess thionyl chloride. Fresh 1,2-dichloroethane and triethylamine were added again, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione and acetone cyanohydrin were charged and held at 40 degrees C for 6 h. The reaction was checked to be complete. The triethylamine salt was filtered off and the mixture concentrated under reduced pressure to give a red-brown solid.
paragraphs.notes: FULL PROCEDURE WITH NO QUANTITIES. Not one charge, volume, equivalent, ratio or yield is printed: every reagent is named without an amount. FIVE THINGS READ AS PRINTED AND NOT CORRECTED. (1) Every locant hyphen inside the chemical names in this paragraph is the non-breaking hyphen U+2011 in this page's text layer, not the ASCII hyphen-minus U+002D, and is preserved verbatim in zh. (2) 1,3-cyclohexanedione is printed with no hyphen between its locants and the ring name, unlike 1,2-dichloroethane in the same sentence which carries one; kept as printed in zh and translated with the hyphen. (3) The reduced pressure is printed with the unit "mP", which is not a pressure unit; -0.098 MPa is the obvious intent, but the page says mP and mP is what is recorded. (4) The paragraph opens with a dangling attributive particle after "added into the three-necked flask", which leaves the sentence without a main verb; translated as though that particle were absent. (5) The starting material named here is the acid CHLORIDE (benzoyl chloride), yet thionyl chloride is then added to it and the excess thionyl chloride distilled off afterwards, which is the treatment for the corresponding acid; [0009] on the previous page states that it is the benzoic acid that reacts with thionyl chloride to give this acid chloride. Recorded as printed, not reconciled.
